title: SecretWrite
description: control-plane-parity.md 5.2. Request-only secret plus a rotation id; the response carries masked metadata, version and status and never echoes the value. The two halves live in $defs so a route can validate the response it is about to return WITHOUT constructing a request object that holds the plaintext -- validating one half used to require the other, which put the secret back in scope at exactly the call site this contract exists to keep it out of (independent review P3-2). `masked` is runtime.redaction.REDACTED, the repository's single redaction marker, not a second spelling of it (P2-2).
